limits: Useful primary base and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; useful donor and uniform advantage is excluded under both. Every primary interval includes zero. Residual pooled and donor useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods; residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both and is worse only under writer resampling. Raw base useful uncertainty remains under both methods, pooled useful advantage is excluded under both and donor uncertainty remains only under crossed resampling. All raw model-rival intervals include zero; raw sums are worse than uniform. Both higher-cap seeds share evaluation units and establish no seed ranking or independent human replication. Actual dose increases for only one writer per seed relative to its main. Selected model-prose provenance, sparse histories, calibration selection and shared or changed support prevent parity or dose/corpus/backbone effects. The second higher-cap human-text attempt is unknown and excluded from comparator verification; the completed first human-text seed supplies its roster comparison. Other frozen cells remain unfinished.
